ind. A prefix substituted for सह or सम्, सम, तुल्य, or सदृश and एक or समान, and compounded with nouns to form adjectives and adverbs in the sense of 
___(a) with, together with, along with, accompanied by, having, possessed of; सपुत्र, सभार्य, सतृष्ण, सधन, सरोषम्, सकोपम्, सहरि &c.; 
___(b) similar, like; सधर्मन् ‘of a similar nature’; so सजाति, सवर्ण; 
___(c) same; सोदर, सपक्ष, सपिण्ड, सनाभि &c. -m.
